Meta Account & Page Routing Invariant: All Meta mutate requests (POST /v25.0/act_{account_id}/...) are strictly routed to the account selected in the "Connected Ad Account" dropdown (form.client_account). The page selected in "Facebook Page" (form.facebook_page) is canonicalized against connected page records, retrieves the specific Page Access Token, and populates object_story_spec.page_id and /canvases. 2. Google Ads & YouTube FormatsAd FormatInternal KeyChannels / SubsystemsStatusKey Features & Implementation HighlightsResponsive Search Ad (RSA)responsive_searchGoogle SearchCompleted & Verified3 to 15 headlines (≤30\le 30≤30 chars), 2 to 4 descriptions (≤90\le 90≤90 chars), display paths (path1, path2), business logo assets, and Sitelink asset linkage with automatic description pairing and duplicate asset recovery.Responsive Display Ad (RDA)responsiveGoogle DisplayCompleted & VerifiedDynamic multi-surface banner format combining landscape images (1.91:1), square logos (1:1), short headlines, long headlines (≤90\le 90≤90 chars), descriptions, and business name across the Google Display Network.Performance Max (PMax)performance_maxPerformance MaxCompleted & VerifiedMulti-channel Asset Group builder featuring 6 media sections with live asset counters (X of 20 added), status badges, YouTube video embeds, headlines, long headlines, and descriptions serving across Search, Display, YouTube, Gmail, Discover, and Maps.YouTube Video Ad (Action / In-Stream)youtube_videoYouTube / Demand GenCompleted & VerifiedYouTube Video ID parser (supporting youtube.com, youtu.be, shorts), interactive video embed player in format builder and Tab 4 preview, Short Headline (≤15\le 15≤15 chars), Long Headline (≤90\le 90≤90 chars), Description (≤70\le 70≤70 chars), and CTA overlay.Dynamic Remarketing / Merchant Feeddynamic_product_adsGoogle Display, Performance MaxCompleted & VerifiedFeed-based dynamic remarketing and product showcasing integrated with Google Merchant Center catalog data and asset groups. Google Account Routing & MCC Decoupling: All Google Ads mutate operations (POST /v18/customers/{customer_id}/googleAds:mutate) are strictly dispatched to the child customer ID chosen in the "Connected Ad Account" dropdown (form.client_account). The MCC Manager CID (2610514193) is passed in the login-customer-id header to satisfy Google Ads authentication without triggering CANNOT_CREATE_UNDER_MANAGER_ACCOUNT. 3. Testing, Quality Gates & Verification Backend System Check: Passed (manage.py check — 0 issues). Test Suite: Passed (104/104 tests passed across apps.ad_mcp and apps.campaigns; all 282 project tests green). Frontend Production Build: Passed (npm run build — 0 errors, assets bundled successfully). Pre-flight Spec Validation: Verified character limits, aspect ratios (±0.01\pm 0.01±0.01 / ±0.025\pm 0.025±0.025), video durations, and budget allocations across all formats. to Project Status Update: Creative Ad Formats & Omnichannel Publishing Engine Executive Summary All Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads / YouTube Creative Ad Formats have completed end-to-end integration across frontend builders, automated media pipelines, and omnichannel publishing. Since the last milestone, major engineering focus was dedicated to Dynamic Product Ads (DPA) & XML Catalog Feeds, eliminating Meta Graph API Error 100 failure modes, introducing intelligent fallback publishing paths, sanitizing ad copy tokens, and enhancing deep linking controls with catalog feed URL extraction. Key Milestones Completed Since Last Update: Dynamic Meta Product Set Discovery & Resilient Dual-Path Execution: Implemented dynamic API lookup for Meta Commerce Manager Product Sets. If an ad account has a linked catalog, ads publish natively using template_data and product_set_id (Path A). If external XML feeds (e.g. Beares, Lewis, Shopify) are not mapped to Meta Commerce Manager, Touchpoint automatically converts the ad unit into a multi-product Carousel creative using up to 10 live feed products (Path B), completely eliminating Meta Error 100 ("no product set ID"). Meta DPA Destination URL Invariant (template_data['link']): Hardened destination URL resolution so that bare, unresolvable strings like {{product.url}} are never sent as the ad-level link. The engine safely falls back to a verified domain/landing page URL, preventing Meta Error 100 ("URL doesn't direct to a website"). Pr
